annotations.title: Check the molecules in a finished figure

description: Check a finished figure (SVG, or HTML with inline SVG) that holds structures Lone Pair drew with embed: true. Each Lone Pair molecule is found by the drawing data inside it and rebuilt from it, then checked: its label (data-inchikey) names that structure; its lines and atom labels are the ones Lone Pair draws for it, drawn the same way (nothing redrawn, relabelled, recoloured, hidden or moved, whether by an attribute, an inline style or a rule in the figure's style sheets); nothing around it hides, clips, stretches, skews or mirrors it (SVG groups, HTML wrappers and their CSS included); and, with `expect`, every structure the figure should show is there, matched by InChIKey (a match on the skeleton only is reported as different stereo or charge). Also gives each molecule's bond length on the page, so all can be scaled to one. Structures drawn any other way, including inside raster images, cannot be checked and are reported as such; nor can anything else drawn on top of a molecule, style sheets in other files, or what a script does. Call it on every figure before showing it, and fix what it reports: draw the molecule again and place the new SVG unchanged.

expect.description: The structures the figure should show, each as SMILES or InChI. Default: none, and only the molecules themselves are checked.

figure.description: The whole figure as text: an SVG, or HTML with the SVG inside.
